name: Mikoko Pamoja, Gazi Bay

location.source: Plan Vivo Project Design Document, 2020 revision (4°25'S, 39°50'E)

tenure: State-owned mangroves. Community rights, including the right to carbon, are held through a Community Forest Association.

keepers.name: Mikoko Pamoja Community Organisation (Gazi and Makongeni villages)
keepers.notes: Owns the carbon credits; income is invested in local projects chosen by community consultation.

keepers.name: Association for Coastal Ecosystem Services (ACES)
keepers.notes: Coordinates the project and submits it to Plan Vivo.

keepers.name: Kenya Marine and Fisheries Research Institute (KMFRI)

claims.statement: The project protects 107 ha of natural mangrove forest and 10 ha of mangrove plantation (117 ha) at Gazi Bay, over 20 years from 2013.
Income from credit sales is invested in local projects chosen by the community, such as water and school materials.
Plan Vivo validated the sale of at least 3,000 tCO2e a year over 2013–2033.

payments.what: Credit income invested in community projects (water, school materials)

consent: Drawn from public project documents and public reporting. No personal data. To be confirmed with the Mikoko Pamoja Community Organisation before the status moves past candidate.
